blocks.label: SCENE CONTEXT
blocks.zh: 场景上下文：以角色计数头开篇（如 EXACT 3 CHARACTERS — NO DUPLICATES），后接场景动作与角色行
blocks.en: Opens with a count header (EXACT 3 CHARACTERS — NO DUPLICATES), then scene action and character lines

blocks.label: GEO SPATIAL LAYOUT
blocks.zh: 地理空间布局：纯场景平面图（地标、左右、相机站位、180° 轴线），不含角色与动作；每场锁定逐镜粘贴不变
blocks.en: Pure floor plan of the place (landmarks, left/right, camera side, 180° axis); no characters, no action; locked across every shot of the scene

blocks.label: ACTION TIMING
blocks.zh: 动作时间线：0.0-2.0s 逐秒动作；镜头运动写进动作；INNER (unspoken) 内心独白；分阶段眨眼与微表情
blocks.en: Per-second action timeline; camera written inside the action; INNER (unspoken) monologue; phased blinking and micro-expressions

blocks.label: AUDIO
blocks.zh: 对白与音效：台词只存在于 AUDIO 块；音色锁定描述符原样粘贴；写明混音（人声近麦、环境底噪、说话时压低）
blocks.en: Dialogue lives only here; voice descriptor pasted verbatim; write the mix (voices close, ambience under, dips when someone speaks)

blocks.label: CHARACTER ACTING
blocks.zh: 角色表演：情绪状态·此刻所求·隐瞒之物·身体节奏·可见习惯·本镜变化；核心行为段永不改变
blocks.en: Emotional state · want in this moment · what they hide · body rhythm · visible habits · what changes across the shot

blocks.label: STYLE
blocks.zh: 风格前缀：逐字粘贴（Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 12s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.）
blocks.en: Style prefix pasted word for word (Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 12s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.)

blocks.label: POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
blocks.zh: 正向锁定：8K 细节、毛孔级皮肤、无抖动闪烁；计数物体以「是什么在画面中」表述；点名失败镜头长什么样
blocks.en: Positive locks: 8K detail, pore-level skin, no jitter; counted objects phrased as what IS in frame; name what a failed shot looks like

rules.title: Assets first
rules.zh: 素材先行：角色/场景/道具全部锁定并压力测试之前，不生成任何一个镜头
rules.en: Do not generate a single shot until every character, location, and prop is locked and stress-tested

rules.title: Describe everything, every time
rules.zh: 每次全量描述：模型没有记忆，描述符逐字粘贴、永不缩写
rules.en: The model has no memory; the descriptor goes into every prompt word for word, never shortened

rules.title: Change one thing at a time
rules.zh: 一次只改一处：整段重写会丢掉生效的部分；每次迭代记录日志
rules.en: Rewrite a prompt fully and you lose the parts that worked; one line per iteration, everything into the log

rules.title: Give the model less freedom
rules.zh: 少给自由：角落而非房间、锚点而非空地、地图而非猜测、每镜一个动作
rules.en: A corner instead of a room, an anchor instead of open space, a map instead of guesswork, one action per shot

rules.title: Simplify the shot, not the words
rules.zh: 镜头不出来就简化镜头：拆成两镜、删一个动作、换角度；10-15 次迭代上限
rules.en: If a shot will not come together in 10-15 iterations, split it, remove an action, change the angle

rules.title: The first second is always a wide
rules.zh: 每场第一秒固定广角：无人声无动作，把站位/光线“拍”进模型
rules.en: One second at the start of a scene, no lines and no action: locks positions and light

rules.title: Physics, not adjectives
rules.zh: 写肌肉不写形容词：颤抖、下颌咬紧、颧骨绷紧、鼻息；静止写成“绷住的张力”而非“别动”
rules.en: Describe the work of muscles and body, not emotion words; stillness as held tension, never a freeze

rules.title: The voice is a locked descriptor
rules.zh: 音色是锁定描述符：register/tempo/accent/manner 在 pre-production 锁定，逐次粘贴
rules.en: Lock register, tempo, accent, manner before any dialogue; pasted as-is every time the character speaks

rules.title: Point changes go on with masks
rules.zh: 点修改用蒙版：衣服/伤疤/血在 Nano Banana 改后手工蒙版合回原图；图片绝不全图二过模型
rules.en: Clothes, scars, blood are point changes masked onto the original; an image never runs through a model twice in full

rules.title: Dialogue lives only in the audio block
rules.zh: 台词只在 AUDIO 块：声音+情绪→引号台词→肢体动作→面部反应；无台词者完全沉默
rules.en: Voice+emotion → line in quotes → physical action → facial reaction; everyone else stays completely silent

glossary.zh: 视频生成模型（Seedance 2.0，剧情镜头主力）
图片生成模型（Nano Banana 2，角色定妆/素材图）
电影感图片模型（氛围/质感图）
引用令牌：<<<uuid>>> 形式的资产引用，逐字保留
glossary.en: Reference token: <<<uuid>>> asset reference kept verbatim

glossary.zh: 角色定妆三视图：面部特写 + 正面无头全身 + 背面全身
glossary.en: Character sheet: face close-up + headless front full-body + back

glossary.zh: 地理空间布局块（每场锁定，逐镜粘贴不变）
glossary.en: Geo spatial layout block (locked per scene)
